question: The Second Five Year Plan which laid down the basic ideas regarding goals of Indian planning was based on the ideas of _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**PC Mahalanobis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Second Five-Year Plan**:

 
 
• The focus of the second five-year plan was **heavy industries**.
 
• **Rapid industrialization **was used to set a goal of a** 25% rise in national income**.
 
• The** Mahalanobis model** is used in the** second five-year plan**. **PC Mahalanobis, the founder of the Indian Statistical Institute** and a close aide of Nehru, Indianized the USSR model.
 
• Through an elaborate input-output model, this approach is known to have provided the statistical foundations for** state-directed investments** and created the intellectual underpinnings of the **licensing raj**.
 
• This concept was used to establish India's second five-year plan and the **Industrial Policy Resolution of 1956**, which cleared the way for the rise of the public sector and the license raj.
 
• The** growth target was 4.50%** but achieved **4.27%**.
 
 
 
• **Ac****hievements of Second Five-Year Plan**:
 
 
• ​In the second five-year plan, **steel mills** were built in** Bhilai, Durgapur, and Rourkela**.
 
• This plan included increased** coal production** and the addition of **extra railway lines**.
 
• **Homi J. Bhabha **was the first head of the** Atomic Energy Commission**, which was established in **1957**.
 
• As a research institute, the **Tata Institute of Fundamental Research **was founded.
 
• A talent search and scholarship program was started in **1957** to locate exceptional young students who could be trained for the** nuclear power industry.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50aeb211c43f6f054267a83d1cf336dfac21a673cacd5421aea3f05c80de5fc.png] 

 
• PC Mahalanobis

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lal Bahadur Shastri**:

 
 
• Lal Bahadur Shastri was an Indian political leader who served as the **second prime minister of India**.
 
• He promoted the** White Revolution** a national campaign to increase the production and** supply of milk **by supporting the** Amul milk co-operative of Anand, Gujarat** and creating the **National Dairy Development Board**.
 
• Shastri also promoted the** Green Revolution** in India in** 1965**. This led to an increase in** food grain production**, especially in **Punjab, Haryana and Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• He led the country during the** Indo-Pakistan War of 1965**. His slogan** "Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan" ("Hail to the soldier; Hail to the farmer") **became very popular during the war.
 
• He died in an abnormal accident in **Tashkent, Uzbekistan**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f46330a841cfb8457f929a17071660de253f22dee3d1cf7f3410eb55852d61c1.png] 

 
• Lal Bahadur Shastri
 
• **BR Ambedkar**:
 
 
• Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar was an I**ndian jurist, economist, social reformer and political leader** who** headed the committee drafting the Constitution of India**.
 
• He served as** Law and Justice Minister** in the first cabinet of Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• He advocated **political rights and social freedom for Dalits**.
 
• He was honoured with the** Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award in **1990** was** posthumous**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e071d095bcf17c4a05eaed017c07bc2c43f947362eaea3d47dcf003237513d.png] 

 
• BR Ambedkar
 
• **Sardar Patel**:
 
 
• Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel was an Indian statesman who is also called the **"Unifier of India"**.
 
• He led India successfully by **integrating the princely states into the newly independent nation** those British colonial provinces that formed the Dominion of India.
 
• He served as the **First Deputy Prime Minister of India**, alongside Prime Minister Pt. Jawaharlal Nehru from 1947 to 1950.
 
• Patel persuaded almost every princely state to accede to India
 
• His commitment to national integration in the newly independent country was total and uncompromising, earning him the sobriquet** "Iron Man of India".**
 
• The** Statue of Unity** which** **is the **world's tallest statue**, with a height of **182 metres (597 feet)** located in the state of** Gujarat**, India depicts his magnificent figure.
